	/* nova_ext_sim_central:webhooks_create v2 START - managed block, do not edit by hand */
	public function create_mission_entry($data = '')
	{
		$result = parent::create_mission_entry($data);

		if ($result > 0) {
			$newId = $this->db->insert_id();

			if ($newId && class_exists('nova_ext_sim_central\\Webhooks')) {
				\nova_ext_sim_central\Webhooks::onPostChanged($newId, $data, null);
			}

			// Change tracking for the REST API's ?updated_since. Gated
			// separately from the webhook call because the two features
			// toggle independently.
			if ($newId && class_exists('nova_ext_sim_central\\SyncTrack')) {
				\nova_ext_sim_central\SyncTrack::onPostChanged($newId);
			}
		}

		return $result;
	}
	/* nova_ext_sim_central:webhooks_create END */
